xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RelatedPartyTransactionExplana: 1. Transactions between JM Financial Limited and its Wholly Owned Subsidiaries are not included. 2. Related Party Transactions of subsidiaries viz. JM financial Credit Solutions Limited and JM Financial Products Limited, which are high value debt listed entities are not included, as these entities have filed their respective disclosures on RPT with the Exchanges. Further, transactions of JM Financial Home Loans Limited and JM Financial Asset Reconstruction Company Limited are also not included, as they are forming part of disclosures on RPT of JM Financial Products Limited and JM Financial Credit Solutions Limited, respectively, filed with the Exchanges. 3. Related party transactions reported above are identified based on PAN of the related party available on record. 4. The value of transactions approved, in case of omnibus approval granted by the committee, were for the financial year 2025-26. Omnibus approvals have been considered only for related parties as per Companies Act, 2013. 5. Non-convertible debentures transactions include only primary issuances. Outstanding balances represent NCDs held by related parties as on reporting date. 6. Rs. 0.00 denotes amount below Rs. 50,000.
